# octopusdeploy_space_default_lifecycle (Resource)

Manages the `Default Lifecycle` that Octopus creates automatically with a space.

The lifecycle cannot be created or deleted through the API: creating this resource adopts the existing lifecycle of the space (the lifecycle named `Default Lifecycle`, or the oldest lifecycle of the space when it has been renamed), and destroying it removes its phases, so that referenced environments can be deleted, and removes it from the Terraform state. The lifecycle itself is deleted together with the space.

Compatible with Octopus 2025.3 and later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "octopusdeploy_space" "example" {
  name                 = "Dev Team Space"
  space_managers_teams = ["teams-everyone"]
}

resource "octopusdeploy_environment" "development" {
  name     = "Development"
  space_id = octopusdeploy_space.example.id
}

resource "octopusdeploy_environment" "production" {
  name     = "Production"
  space_id = octopusdeploy_space.example.id
}

# Configures the "Default Lifecycle" that Octopus creates together with the space
resource "octopusdeploy_space_default_lifecycle" "example" {
  space_id    = octopusdeploy_space.example.id
  name        = "Default Lifecycle"
  description = "Managed by Terraform."

  phases = [
    {
      name                         = "Development"
      automatic_deployment_targets = [octopusdeploy_environment.development.id]
    },
    {
      name                        = "Production"
      optional_deployment_targets = [octopusdeploy_environment.production.id]
      release_retention_with_strategy = {
        strategy = "Forever"
      }
    },
  ]

  release_retention_with_strategy = {
    strategy         = "Count"
    quantity_to_keep = 30
    unit             = "Days"
  }

  tentacle_retention_with_strategy = {
    strategy = "Default"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) The ID of the space whose default lifecycle is managed.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the default lifecycle. When omitted, the existing description is kept.
- `name` (String) The name of the default lifecycle. When omitted, the existing name is kept.
- `phases` (Attributes List) The phases of the default lifecycle. When omitted, the lifecycle has no explicit phases and all environments are available. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases))
- `release_retention_with_strategy` (Attributes) Defines the release retention policy of the default lifecycle. When omitted, the space-wide "Default" retention policy is used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--release_retention_with_strategy))
- `tentacle_retention_with_strategy` (Attributes) Defines the tentacle retention policy of the default lifecycle. When omitted, the space-wide "Default" retention policy is used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tentacle_retention_with_strategy))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID for this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--phases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of this phase.

Optional:

- `automatic_deployment_targets` (List of String) Environment IDs in this phase that a release is automatically deployed to when it is eligible for this phase
- `is_optional_phase` (Boolean) If false a release must be deployed to this phase before it can be deployed to the next phase.
- `is_priority_phase` (Boolean) Deployments will be prioritized in this phase
- `minimum_environments_before_promotion` (Number) The number of units required before a release can enter the next phase. If 0, all environments are required.
- `optional_deployment_targets` (List of String) Environment IDs in this phase that a release can be deployed to, but is not automatically deployed to
- `release_retention_with_strategy` (Attributes) Defines the release retention policy for this phase. When omitted, the phase inherits the retention from the lifecycle. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--release_retention_with_strategy))
- `tentacle_retention_with_strategy` (Attributes) Defines the tentacle retention policy for this phase. When omitted, the phase inherits the retention from the lifecycle. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--tentacle_retention_with_strategy))

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique ID for this phase.

<a id="nestedatt--phases--release_retention_with_strategy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.release_retention_with_strategy`

Required:

- `strategy` (String) How retention will be set. Valid strategies are `Default`, `Forever`, and `Count`.
  - `strategy = "Default"`, is used if the retention is set by the space-wide default lifecycle retention policy.
  - `strategy = "Forever"`, is used if items should never be deleted.
  - `strategy = "Count"`, is used if a specific number of days/releases should be kept.

Optional:

- `quantity_to_keep` (Number) The number of days/releases to keep. Required when `strategy` is `Count`.
- `unit` (String) The unit of quantity to keep. Valid units are Days or Items. Required when `strategy` is `Count`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import [options] octopusdeploy_space_default_lifecycle.<name> <space-id>

# or, to import a specific lifecycle (for example one that has been renamed)
terraform import [options] octopusdeploy_space_default_lifecycle.<name> <space-id>:<lifecycle-id>
```
